app.name: Galmee Pharmacy
app.tagline: See which drugs expire next month and how much money is sitting in them.

common.offlineBody: Galmee will reconnect automatically. Sales you make offline will sync when the internet is back.

auth.checkEmail: Check your email and open the link to confirm your account, then log in.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errorPassword: Password must be at least 10 characters.

onboarding.title: Set up your pharmacy
onboarding.intro: One last step: tell us about your pharmacy.
onboarding.error: Could not create the pharmacy. Please try again.
onboarding.errorPhone: Enter an Ethiopian phone number, for example 0911 234 567.

stock.title: Stock
stock.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
stock.empty: No stock yet. Receive your first delivery.
stock.noResults: Nothing matches. Try another name or filter.
stock.capped: Showing the first {count}. Search to narrow the list.
stock.loadError: Could not load stock. Check your connection and try again.

receive.title: Receive stock
receive.noMatch: No drug found with that name.
receive.expiryHint: Enter the date printed on the box. We show it in the Ethiopian calendar.
receive.expiryPreview: {date}, {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
receive.noItemsYet: Your drug list is empty. Add drugs before receiving stock.
receive.errorItem: Choose a drug from the list.
receive.errorExpiryRequired: Enter the expiry date printed on the box.
receive.errorExpired: That date has passed. Expired stock cannot be received.
receive.errorNoLines: Add at least one drug to the delivery.
receive.errorSupplierDuplicate: That supplier is already on your list.
receive.errorForbidden: Only the owner or a manager can receive stock.
receive.errorNotFound: A drug or supplier in this delivery no longer exists. Check the list and try again.
receive.errorGeneric: Could not record the delivery. Check your connection and try again. It will not be counted twice.
